item.title: Platform Update Notice – September 2024 (effective date of September 26)
item.content:encoded:
Dear users,

We are excited to announce a new update to the NAVER Performance DA platform in September 2024.

This update includes the following:

■ Changes

[1] How the Open API integrates

■ Details

[1] Location

API > Ad API > Creatives > Changes to parameters/responses within the List of Creatives API

  • Effective Date

    Thursday, September 26, 2024

  • Changes Made

    • The ‘campaignNo’ field is deleted upon retrieval of the List of Creatives API
    • The 'adSetName’, ‘campaignName’, and ‘campaignNo' are deleted within the response of the List of Creatives API

If you have any questions, feel free to contact us at https://gfa.naver.com/loginAccount/qna.

Thank you!

Best regards, The NAVER Performance DA Open API Team
